justification: All four critical facts are clearly present and accurate: 8 available vs reorder point of 20, ORD-007 demanding 50 units (2.5× the threshold), 3-day lead times for both suppliers, and the diagnosis correctly blames the reorder point/demand mismatch rather than supplier performance. The only missing element is the important (non-critical) detail about PO-008 being in transit with 150 units arriving too late for ORD-007.
facts_found: Available stock 8 units, reorder point 20, needs_reorder true
ORD-007 is processing with urgent priority requesting 50 units
SUP-001 and SUP-004 both have 3-day lead times
Diagnosis explicitly links stockout to mismatch between reorder point and large-order demand, not supplier failure
Recommendation to raise reorder point to ~50 units and add advance-notice workflow for large orders
Shelf life tension (7 days) acknowledged as complicating factor for large buffers
facts_missing: PO-008 in transit with 150 units arriving after ORD-007 was needed
